ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.summary: The open source durable AI runtime for model training and batch/online inference

tests.script: python -X utf8 -c "from flyte.cli.main import main; main(['--help'])"

ignore=(
  # need pydantic-monty 1.0, conda-forge only has 0.0.1
  tests/flyte/orchestrator/test_local_runs.py
  tests/flyte/orchestrator/test_conditions.py
  # need docker
  tests/flyte/imagebuild/test_docker_builder.py
  tests/flyte/test_int_image_builder.py
)
deselect=(
  # need docker
  tests/flyte/imagebuild/test_image_build_engine.py::test_cached
  tests/flyte/imagebuild/test_image_build_engine.py::test_build_looks_up_in_the_explicit_build_queue
  tests/flyte/imagebuild/test_image_build_engine.py::test_local_docker
  # need kubectl
  tests/cli/test_devbox.py::TestMergeKubeconfigRetry
  tests/cli/test_devbox.py::TestMergeKubeconfigWindows
  # needs google-cloud-bigquery
  tests/flyte/type_engine/test_dataframe.py::test_reregister_encoder
  # assumes a dev (unreleased) flyte version
  tests/flyte/test_image.py::test_default_base_image
  # click 8.5 reworded the message
  tests/cli/test_main_options.py::test_unknown_option_keeps_click_message
  # rattler-build puts the tests under $PREFIX/etc/conda/test-files/flyte/,
  # which flyte treats as SDK code (path has /flyte/) or an environment dir
  tests/flyte/roundtrip/test_round_trip.py::test_launch_remote_success
  tests/flyte/roundtrip/test_round_trip.py::test_launch_remote_err
  tests/flyte/roundtrip/test_round_trip.py::test_launch_remote_success_interactive
  tests/flyte/roundtrip/test_round_trip.py::test_launch_remote_err_interactive
  tests/flyte/type_engine/test_dataframe.py::test_setting_of_unset_formats
  tests/user_api/test_environment.py::test_environment_include_populates_declaring_file
  tests/user_api/test_task_environment.py::test_task_environment_include_populates_declaring_file
  # calls ps, which isn't in the CI image
  tests/flyte/apple_silicon/test_robustness.py::test_stopping_kills_the_whole_process_group
  # reads the repo's plugins/ directory
  tests/test_plugin_install_names.py::test_installable_plugin_names_are_published_by_this_repo
  # patches time.monotonic, which stalls the asyncio loop for ~3 minutes per test on osx
  tests/user_api/test_workload_token_auth.py::TestWorkloadTokenAuthenticator
  # timing-dependent, the fake daemon doesn't die mid-request on the slower osx runner
  tests/flyte/apple_silicon/test_bridge.py::test_oom_kill_is_surfaced_not_silent
  # order-dependent under xdist (an lru_cache'd helper gets filled while other tests mock pyqwest)
  tests/flyte/remote/test_session.py::TestBuildPyqwestClient::test_detects_system_cert_support_from_signature
  # order-dependent under xdist: inspect.getsource() on the cloudpickled task
  # fails or passes depending on which tests ran before it in the same worker
  tests/flyte/clustered/test_serde.py::test_custom_survives_pickle_roundtrip
)
args=()
for path in "${ignore[@]}"; do args+=("--ignore=$path"); done
for test in "${deselect[@]}"; do args+=("--deselect=$test"); done
# Same marker filter as upstream's `make unit_test`: skips the tests that
# need a Flyte backend or the S3 sandbox on localhost:4566.
pytest -v -n auto tests -o asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope=function \
  -m "not integration and not sandbox" "${args[@]}"

name: flyte
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.13.1"

package:
  name: flyte
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # PyPI only has a wheel.
  url: https://github.com/flyteorg/flyte-sdk/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: dbaabd6f799ee3c2ff3dd9f834d6cd4631d4de88c8ace23925892612d25ebb4e

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script:
    env:
      SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION: ${{ version }}
    content:
      # include-package-data relies on setuptools-scm's git file finder, which
      # finds nothing in the tarball, so py.typed and report/_template.html
      # would be left out. https://github.com/flyteorg/flyte/issues/8430
      - if: unix
        then: cp ${{ RECIPE_DIR }}/MANIFEST.in MANIFEST.in
        else: copy ${{ RECIPE_DIR }}\MANIFEST.in MANIFEST.in
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - flyte = flyte.cli.main:main
      - a0 = flyte._bin.runtime:main
      - clustered = flyte._bin.clustered:main
      - fserve = flyte._bin.serve:main
      - c0 = flyte._bin.connect:main
      - flyte-mcp = flyte._bin.mcp:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-scm
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - aiofiles >=24.1.0
    - click >=8.2.1
    - cloudpickle >=3.1.1
    - docstring_parser >=0.16
    - fsspec >=2025.3.0
    - connectrpc >=0.9.0,<0.11
    - obstore >=0.7.3
    - protobuf >=6.30.1
    - pydantic >=2.10.6
    - pyyaml >=6.0.2
    - rich-click ==1.8.9
    - httpx >=0.28.1,<1.0.0
    - keyring >=25.6.0
    - msgpack-python >=1.1.0
    - toml >=0.10.2
    - async-lru >=2.0.5
    - mashumaro >=3.15
    - aiolimiter >=1.2.1
    - flyteidl2 ==2.0.54
    - packaging
    - sentry-sdk >=2.0
    - pyopenssl >=24.0.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - flyte
        - flyte.cli.main
        - flyte.io
        - flyte.remote
        - flyte.storage
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      # rich-click help output needs UTF-8 on Windows CI.
      - python -X utf8 -c "from flyte.cli.main import main; main(['--help'])"
  # Upstream only runs the suite on Linux.
  - if: not win
    then:
      files:
        source:
          - tests/
      requirements:
        run:
          - python ${{ python_min }}.*
          - pytest
          - pytest-asyncio
          - pytest-xdist
          - mock
          - grpcio
          - fastapi
          - uvicorn
          - starlette
          - pandas
          - pyarrow
          - mcp >=1.26.0,<2
          - textual >=0.80
          # kubernetes 37 turned its models into pydantic models that reject
          # the int CPU values flyte passes; upstream locks 35.
          - python-kubernetes >=35,<37
          - prometheus_client
          - regex >=2024.5.15
          - orjson
          - asyncssh >=2.14
          - ruff
      script:
        - |
          ignore=(
            # need pydantic-monty 1.0, conda-forge only has 0.0.1
            tests/flyte/orchestrator/test_local_runs.py
            tests/flyte/orchestrator/test_conditions.py
            # need docker
            tests/flyte/imagebuild/test_docker_builder.py
            tests/flyte/test_int_image_builder.py
          )
          deselect=(
            # need docker
            tests/flyte/imagebuild/test_image_build_engine.py::test_cached
            tests/flyte/imagebuild/test_image_build_engine.py::test_build_looks_up_in_the_explicit_build_queue
            tests/flyte/imagebuild/test_image_build_engine.py::test_local_docker
            # need kubectl
            tests/cli/test_devbox.py::TestMergeKubeconfigRetry
            tests/cli/test_devbox.py::TestMergeKubeconfigWindows
            # needs google-cloud-bigquery
            tests/flyte/type_engine/test_dataframe.py::test_reregister_encoder
            # assumes a dev (unreleased) flyte version
            tests/flyte/test_image.py::test_default_base_image
            # click 8.5 reworded the message
            tests/cli/test_main_options.py::test_unknown_option_keeps_click_message
            # rattler-build puts the tests under $PREFIX/etc/conda/test-files/flyte/,
            # which flyte treats as SDK code (path has /flyte/) or an environment dir
            tests/flyte/roundtrip/test_round_trip.py::test_launch_remote_success
            tests/flyte/roundtrip/test_round_trip.py::test_launch_remote_err
            tests/flyte/roundtrip/test_round_trip.py::test_launch_remote_success_interactive
            tests/flyte/roundtrip/test_round_trip.py::test_launch_remote_err_interactive
            tests/flyte/type_engine/test_dataframe.py::test_setting_of_unset_formats
            tests/user_api/test_environment.py::test_environment_include_populates_declaring_file
            tests/user_api/test_task_environment.py::test_task_environment_include_populates_declaring_file
            # calls ps, which isn't in the CI image
            tests/flyte/apple_silicon/test_robustness.py::test_stopping_kills_the_whole_process_group
            # reads the repo's plugins/ directory
            tests/test_plugin_install_names.py::test_installable_plugin_names_are_published_by_this_repo
            # patches time.monotonic, which stalls the asyncio loop for ~3 minutes per test on osx
            tests/user_api/test_workload_token_auth.py::TestWorkloadTokenAuthenticator
            # timing-dependent, the fake daemon doesn't die mid-request on the slower osx runner
            tests/flyte/apple_silicon/test_bridge.py::test_oom_kill_is_surfaced_not_silent
            # order-dependent under xdist (an lru_cache'd helper gets filled while other tests mock pyqwest)
            tests/flyte/remote/test_session.py::TestBuildPyqwestClient::test_detects_system_cert_support_from_signature
            # order-dependent under xdist: inspect.getsource() on the cloudpickled task
            # fails or passes depending on which tests ran before it in the same worker
            tests/flyte/clustered/test_serde.py::test_custom_survives_pickle_roundtrip
          )
          args=()
          for path in "${ignore[@]}"; do args+=("--ignore=$path"); done
          for test in "${deselect[@]}"; do args+=("--deselect=$test"); done
          # Same marker filter as upstream's `make unit_test`: skips the tests that
          # need a Flyte backend or the S3 sandbox on localhost:4566.
          pytest -v -n auto tests -o asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope=function \
            -m "not integration and not sandbox" "${args[@]}"

about:
  homepage: https://flyte.org
  repository: https://github.com/flyteorg/flyte-sdk
  summary: The open source durable AI runtime for model training and batch/online inference
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - killua156
